name: Chance Fracture / Flexion-Distraction Injury
definition: Flexion-distraction injury of the thoracolumbar spine, classically associated with lap-belt trauma and possible intra-abdominal injury.

investigations.principle: CT defines osseous injury; MRI assesses posterior ligament complex and neural injury.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when the condition-specific question requires soft-tissue, neural, marrow or occult-injury assessment.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs/CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Unstable ligamentous injuries frequently require surgery.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Bhagna/Abhighata documentation is secondary to trauma management.

patientEducation.summary: Flexion-distraction injury of the thoracolumbar spine, classically associated with lap-belt trauma and possible intra-abdominal injury.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for major trauma, acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe infection/systemic illness, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
